settings.editor: Battery advice should start with the existing solar system, not with a battery model or sales pitch. Inverter type, available capacity, backup goals and daily energy use all shape the right storage conversation. This section helps Dallas-Fort Worth homeowners define the job before comparing solar battery add-on options.

A battery should be sized for the job it needs to do, not for a vague idea of backup power. Whole-home expectations and essential-load plans can lead to very different equipment choices. This section explains why load lists, outage duration and inverter limits matter before a Dallas-Fort Worth owner commits to storage.
